name: Barbell bench press
steps: Plant your feet and keep your upper back supported
Lower the bar toward your lower chest with wrists above elbows, then press up.
avoid: Bouncing the bar; lifting your hips. Use rack safeties or a spotter.

name: Seated cable row
steps: Sit tall with soft knees
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, then reach forward with control.
avoid: Rocking your torso to move the weight.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
steps: Sit against a supported bench
Start dumbbells near shoulder height and press overhead with forearms under the weights.
avoid: Overarching your lower back or clashing the weights.

name: Barbell squat
steps: Set rack safeties
Brace with the bar on your upper back
Bend hips and knees together, then stand through your whole foot.
avoid: Heels lifting or knees collapsing inward. Use a depth you can control.

name: Romanian deadlift
steps: Start standing with the bar near your thighs
Keep knees softly bent, push hips back and keep the bar close
Stand by extending your hips.
avoid: Turning the hinge into a squat or chasing depth by rounding your back.

name: Leg press
steps: Adjust the seat so your back and pelvis stay supported
Lower the sled with knees tracking your toes, then press away.
avoid: Letting your pelvis curl off the pad or forcefully snapping knees straight.

name: Incline barbell bench press
steps: Set a modest bench incline and plant your feet
Lower the bar toward your upper chest with forearms under it, then press.
avoid: Bouncing at the bottom or losing upper-back support. Use safeties or a spotter.

name: Dumbbell bench press
steps: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted
Lower dumbbells beside your chest with wrists over elbows, then press up.
avoid: Dropping too deep for your shoulders or banging weights together.

name: Incline dumbbell bench press
steps: Use a modest incline with feet grounded
Lower dumbbells beside your upper chest and press smoothly upward.
avoid: Excessive back arch or flaring elbows straight out.

name: Dumbbell chest fly
steps: Lie on a bench with a small, steady elbow bend
Open your arms in an arc within a comfortable range, then bring weights together.
avoid: Turning it into a press or overstretching your shoulders.

name: Cable chest fly
steps: With high pulleys, take a staggered stance and a slight forward lean
Keep elbows softly bent as you sweep hands together in front.
avoid: Swinging your torso or letting cables pull your shoulders too far back.

name: Machine chest press
steps: Adjust the seat so handles sit around chest height
Keep your back supported, press forward and return slowly.
avoid: Shrugging or lifting your back from the pad.

name: Pec deck
steps: Set the seat so arms are near chest height
Keep your back supported as you bring the pads or handles together.
avoid: Forcing a deep stretch or using momentum.

name: Push-up
steps: Place hands just wider than shoulders
Brace in a straight line, lower your chest between your hands, then push away.
avoid: Sagging hips or jutting your head forward. Elevate hands to make it easier.

name: Dip
steps: Support yourself on parallel bars
Lower by bending elbows through a comfortable shoulder range, then press up.
avoid: Swinging or forcing a deep shoulder stretch. Use assistance when needed.

name: Lat pulldown
steps: Secure the thigh pad
With a slight backward lean, pull the bar toward your upper chest and return under control.
avoid: Pulling behind your neck or swinging your body.

name: Pull-up
steps: Use an overhand grip
Brace and pull elbows down until your chin clears the bar, then lower with control.
avoid: Kipping or reaching your chin instead of lifting your body. Use assistance if needed.

name: Chin-up
steps: Use an underhand grip
Pull elbows toward your sides, bring your chin over the bar and lower smoothly.
avoid: Swinging your legs or dropping into the bottom. Use assistance if needed.

name: Barbell bent-over row
steps: Hinge at your hips with soft knees and a braced torso
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, then lower it.
avoid: Jerking your torso upright each rep.

name: One-arm dumbbell row
steps: Support one hand and knee on a bench
Keep hips level and pull the dumbbell toward your hip, then lower.
avoid: Twisting your torso or shrugging the weight up.

name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with feet stable
Pull elbows back and lower dumbbells with control.
avoid: Lifting your chest from the pad or craning your neck.

name: Machine row
steps: Adjust the seat and chest pad to reach the handles
Keep your chest supported while pulling elbows back.
avoid: Jerking away from the pad or shrugging.

name: Straight-arm pulldown
steps: Face a high pulley with a slight hip hinge and soft elbows
Sweep the bar toward your thighs, then return slowly.
avoid: Bending elbows into a pressdown or arching your back.

name: Barbell deadlift
steps: Place the bar over midfoot
Grip outside your legs, brace and push the floor away, keeping the bar close
Stand tall, then lower by hinging and bending knees.
avoid: Jerking the bar off the floor or leaning back at lockout.

name: Trap bar deadlift
steps: Stand centered in the trap bar
Grip handles, brace and push through your feet to stand, then lower under control.
avoid: Uneven loading or rounding to reach handles. Use raised handles if needed.

name: Barbell overhead press
steps: Stand with the bar at your upper chest and forearms under it
Brace glutes and trunk, press overhead and lower to the start.
avoid: Using leg drive or leaning back to finish the rep.

name: Machine shoulder press
steps: Adjust the seat so handles start around shoulder height
Keep your back supported, press up and lower slowly.
avoid: Overarching your back or forcing an uncomfortable bottom position.

name: Dumbbell lateral raise
steps: Stand tall with soft elbows
Raise arms out and slightly forward toward shoulder height, then lower slowly.
avoid: Swinging the weights or aggressively shrugging.

name: Dumbbell front raise
steps: Stand braced with weights at your thighs
Lift in front toward shoulder height with soft elbows, then lower.
avoid: Leaning backward or throwing the weight up.

name: Reverse pec deck
steps: Face the pad with handles near shoulder height
Open your arms with a slight elbow bend and return slowly.
avoid: Lifting your chest away from the support or forcing range.

name: Face pull
steps: Use a high cable and rope
Pull toward your face while separating the rope ends beside your head, then return smoothly.
avoid: Leaning back to move the load or cranking your neck forward.

name: Dumbbell shrug
steps: Stand tall with weights at your sides
Raise shoulders upward, pause, then lower fully with control.
avoid: Rolling shoulders or bending elbows to lift the weights.

name: Barbell curl
steps: Hold the bar palms up with elbows near your sides
Curl without moving your upper arms, then lower slowly.
avoid: Rocking your hips or bending wrists backward.

name: EZ-bar curl
steps: Choose a comfortable angled grip
Keep elbows near your sides as you curl and lower the bar.
avoid: Swinging your torso or lifting elbows to finish.

name: Dumbbell curl
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides
Curl with palms turning upward and elbows steady, then lower.
avoid: Swinging or letting shoulders do the lift.

name: Hammer curl
steps: Keep palms facing inward and wrists straight
Curl with elbows by your sides, then lower under control.
avoid: Rocking your torso or folding wrists.

name: Preacher curl
steps: Adjust the seat so upper arms rest on the pad
Curl up and lower slowly to a comfortable elbow extension.
avoid: Bouncing at the bottom or lifting arms from the pad.

name: Cable biceps curl
steps: Face a low pulley
Keep elbows near your sides and curl the handle upward, then return slowly.
avoid: Leaning back or letting the stack slam.

name: Triceps pushdown
steps: Stand facing a high pulley with elbows tucked near your sides
Straighten elbows to push down, then return.
avoid: Moving your shoulders or using your body weight to push.

name: Overhead cable triceps extension
steps: Face away from the cable in a stable stance with rope behind your head
Keep upper arms steady as you extend elbows.
avoid: Flaring your ribs or moving the upper arms excessively.

name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension
steps: Hold one dumbbell securely overhead with both hands
Bend elbows to lower behind your head, then extend.
avoid: Arching your back or forcing elbows into an uncomfortable position.

name: EZ-bar skull crusher
steps: Lie on a bench with the EZ-bar above you
Keep upper arms steady as you bend elbows to lower near your forehead, then extend.
avoid: Dropping the bar toward your face. Start light and use a spotter when needed.

name: Front squat
steps: Rack the bar on the front of your shoulders with elbows high
Brace, squat between your hips and stand through the whole foot.
avoid: Letting elbows drop or heels lift. Set rack safeties.

name: Goblet squat
steps: Hold a dumbbell close to your chest
Brace, bend hips and knees together, then stand through your whole foot.
avoid: Letting knees cave in or the weight drift away from your chest.

name: Hack squat
steps: Set shoulders and back against the pads
Release the safety handles, lower with knees tracking toes and push back up.
avoid: Letting hips leave the pad or snapping knees straight. Re-engage safeties before exiting.

name: Smith machine squat
steps: Set safety stops and find a stance that suits the fixed bar path
Brace, lower with knees tracking toes and stand.
avoid: Forcing an awkward stance or lifting heels. Lock the bar before stepping away.

name: Bulgarian split squat
steps: Rest your rear foot on a stable bench, front foot far enough forward to balance
Lower through the front leg, then stand.
avoid: Pushing mainly through the rear leg or losing knee alignment. Train both sides.

name: Dumbbell lunge
steps: Hold dumbbells at your sides
Step forward, lower both knees with control and push back to standing.
avoid: Stepping on a tightrope or letting the front knee cave in. Train both sides.

name: Dumbbell step-up
steps: Use a stable platform you can control
Place the whole working foot on it, stand up and step down slowly.
avoid: Jumping off the trailing foot or dropping on the descent. Train both sides.

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
steps: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs
With soft knees, push hips back and slide weights close to your legs, then stand.
avoid: Squatting instead of hinging or lowering beyond a stable back position.

name: Barbell hip thrust
steps: Support your upper back on a stable bench and pad the bar across your hips
Drive through your feet until hips extend, then lower.
avoid: Overarching your lower back instead of extending your hips.

name: Leg extension
steps: Align your knees with the machine pivot and pad above your ankles
Straighten knees smoothly and lower slowly.
avoid: Kicking the stack or lifting hips from the seat.

name: Seated leg curl
steps: Align knees with the machine pivot and secure the thigh pad
Curl heels down and back, then return slowly.
avoid: Lifting hips or letting the stack crash.

name: Lying leg curl
steps: Lie face-down with knees aligned to the pivot and pad above your heels
Curl heels toward your glutes, then lower.
avoid: Lifting hips off the pad or arching your back.

name: Hip abduction machine
steps: Sit supported with pads against the outside of your thighs
Press knees apart through a controlled range, then return.
avoid: Bouncing or rocking your torso to force a wider range.

name: Hip adduction machine
steps: Set a comfortable starting width with pads inside your thighs
Bring legs together, then open slowly.
avoid: Forcing a wide stretch or slamming the pads together.

name: Standing calf raise
steps: Set the balls of your feet on the platform with a stable support
Rise onto your toes, pause and lower heels slowly.
avoid: Bouncing at the bottom or rolling ankles outward.

name: Seated calf raise
steps: Place balls of feet on the platform and secure the thigh pad
Raise heels, pause and lower with control.
avoid: Bouncing or using your arms to lift the pad.

name: Cable crunch
steps: Kneel beneath a high pulley holding the rope near your head
Bring ribs toward pelvis by curling your trunk, then return slowly.
avoid: Pulling with your arms or only hinging at the hips.

name: Crunch
steps: Lie with knees bent and feet planted
Curl your ribs toward your pelvis to lift shoulder blades, then lower.
avoid: Pulling on your neck or swinging into a full sit-up.

name: Hanging knee raise
steps: Hang with a secure grip and active shoulders
Bend knees and curl them toward your torso, then lower slowly.
avoid: Swinging for momentum or dropping legs abruptly.

name: Lying leg raise
steps: Lie supported on a bench or floor
Brace your abdomen, raise legs and lower only as far as your back stays controlled.
avoid: Arching your lower back as legs descend. Bend knees to reduce difficulty.

name: Ab wheel rollout
steps: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders
Brace your abdomen and glutes, roll forward a short distance and pull back.
avoid: Letting your lower back sag or rolling farther than you can control.

name: Back extension
steps: Set the pad just below your hip crease and secure your feet
Hinge at the hips, then return until your body is in line.
avoid: Hyperextending your lower back at the top or bouncing.
